_source: The quoting of names by rm -v, rm (a missing name), mkdir (an existing name), cp -v, mv -v, touch -d (a name as the date), rm -i (the prompt), rmdir, and for GNU mkdir -v, rm -rv of a folder, cp of a folder without -r, mv -T onto a folder, rmdir -v and cp onto the same file, recorded 2026-10-21 with sh -c in containers as fs_tools.json (the same images and locales): each case key is the JSON of the name (bytes of no UTF-8 character as surrogates), set into $n with printf and passed as -- "$n". The GNU tools write names with quoteaf (shell-escape-always) in most messages and with quote() (the locale's quotes, C escapes) in 'invalid date format' and 'cannot create directory'; BusyBox writes the bytes as they are.
